literal_text: Advanced Veterinary Specialty Center of New England (AVSC) provides compassionate, innovative neurology, oncology and orthopedic care in Walpole, MA. Serving Greater Boston, Massachusetts and New England.
Committed to providing easy access to compassionate, innovative specialty veterinary care in Massachusetts and New England.

Advanced Veterinary Specialty Center of New England (AVSC) is committed to providing easy access to compassionate, innovative neurology, oncology and orthopedic care. Founded and led by Dr. Stephanie Kube, AVSC (formerly known as Veterinary Neurology & Pain Management Center of New England) has been a leader in veterinary specialty care since 2014. In 2025, our new, 18,000 sq ft, state-of-the-art facility opened, allowing us to serve more pet patients and offer more specialties.

Our board-certified veterinary specialists have extensive experience gained through years of advanced study and training as well as on-going education and training to provide the most advanced treatment options available. We offer immediate access to specialized testing such as MRI, CT, digital radiography, bloodwork, and electrodiagnostics, as well as specialized treatments including orthopedic surgery and neurosurgery (brain surgery and spinal cord surgery). We also offer a full approach to treatments with rehabilitation services on premises including LASER, underwater treadmill, manual therapies and hyperbaric oxygen treatment.

All pets deserve the greatest quality of life that is medically possible. We are committed to treating your pet like our own, with the quality care your dog or cat deserves. We take a collaborative approach and want you and your veterinarian to remain closely involved in the diagnostic and treatment process that is best for your pet.
Our mission is to enable easy access to compassionate, state-of-the-art specialty veterinary care in a collaborative and personalized environment.

Our vision is to be the leading multi-specialty veterinary practice in New England by using our extensive knowledge, training, and state-of-the-art equipment to offer the most advanced specialty care to our patients.
